notes.title: Check out the new trailer!
notes.content:
Get ready for an adrenaline rush! The latest trailer is packed with explosive new upgrades from our brand-new demo:

* Weaponized Mayhem: Lock and load with a devastating new arsenal – from the hard-hitting "Beer Blaster" to the flashy "Cocktail Uzi" and the elegant "Lady Cricket" – find your perfect fit!
* Smooth as Butter Gunplay: Experience even smoother and more realistic firing and reloading animations – every shot packs a punch!
* Killer Soundtrack & Voiceovers: Immerse yourself in the action with a completely revamped soundtrack and audio experience!
* Revamped Battlegrounds: Explore completely redesigned levels that will force you to adapt and master new tactics!

Craving fast-paced, non-stop action? [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/690210/Roboholic/]Sign up for our playtest[/url] to be among the first to experience our new first-person shooter roguelike demo!

[previewyoutube=fQcoZCx6hpo;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Playtest registration is open!
notes.content:
Go to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/690210/Roboholic/]game main page[/url] and click - Request access.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34060473/ebd2643a91270c46f554756ad6e1f7b3db74e828.png[/img]

A large open playtest is planned for [b]November. [/b]


Right now we are conducting a series of closed playtests to identify bugs and polish the demo.

If you are interested in participating, write to aaredyota@gmail.com

We will ask you to send a recording of the game or play with a screen demonstration in Discord.

What will be in the new demo?
1. Significantly improved player controller, fire and reload animations
2. The game has become more dynamic, a style assessment system has been added, it gives boost in shooting speed and movement
3. New and varied weapons
4. New levels

notes.title: Vote in the second stage of the competition and what will be in the new Demo!
notes.content:
Roboholic has made it to the second stage of the contest, please support us again by voting.
There will be a large cash prize for winning, we plan to spend it on a new cool trailer!

Just click on Roboholic, no registration or additional confirmation required!

1. New fast gameplay.
2. New shooting and reloading animations
3. Playstyle rating systems

notes.title: Roboholic - demo is avalaible! And we participiate in Steam fest Dinos vs Robots
notes.content:
Roboholic participates in the Steam festival - Dinosaurs vs Robots, so we have prepared a new demo! What's new?

1. New diverse levels
2. Physics and overall game optimization
3. More content added - guns/abilities, new interesting perks
4. Progression after death
5. Levels map with branches

To support the project, please fill out the form, it opens in the browser after you close the game.
This will greatly help us, to further improve the game!
